video_title: Former Suns owner Jerry Colangelo bids on the Las Vegas NBA franchise

quotes.speaker: Jerry Colangelo
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Colangelo on the challenges of bidding for an NBA franchise
quotes.excerpt: when you're on the other side of the fence and now you're trying to figure out what's the best next move
quotes.quote: It's interesting to me because there was a time as chairman of the board of the owners and responsible for expansion and negotiating all those deals. When you're on the other side of the fence and now you're trying to figure out what's the best next move, you do the best you can and then you hope and pray that it works out that way.
